THE CUEPROMPT CREATOR GUIDE

Free Teleprompter for YouTube Videos

Keep your story flowing.

A good YouTube script gives your video direction. A teleprompter keeps that direction visible while you explain an idea, film a tutorial, or introduce your next episode. CuePrompt lets you practice and record from the same browser tab.

Try the free teleprompter →

Write for the ear, not the page

Use short sentences and natural transitions. Read the script aloud once before you record, then change any phrases you would never say in conversation. Leave a blank line between ideas so you can see where to pause.

Find a pace that sounds like you

Start with a slower scroll speed and a comfortable text size. Place the preview close to your lens to reduce visible eye movement. Try the YouTube intro template, replace it with your own story, and rehearse before enabling the camera.

Private by design

Your draft is saved on this device using browser storage. No account is required. Export a copy of important scripts before clearing your browser data. Camera recordings are created locally and downloaded when you stop a take.
